description: This is a Java unit test class for the KuraProtocolAdapter, verifying its behavior in mapping MQTT topics to resource identifiers and ensuring correct handling of control and data messages within the Kura/Vert.x framework.

classes.name: KuraProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying the behavior of the KuraProtocolAdapter, particularly its message mapping logic based on MQTT topics, QoS, and configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test, setting up configuration and adapter instances.

methods.name: testMapTopicMapsKuraControlMessagesToEventApi
methods.description: Tests that control messages with QoS 1 are correctly mapped to the Event API endpoint and are recognized as control messages.

methods.name: testMapTopicMapsKuraControlMessagesToTelemetryApi
methods.description: Tests that control messages with QoS 0 are mapped to the Telemetry API endpoint with a custom content type.

methods.name: testMapTopicRecognizesControlMessagesWithCustomControlPrefix
methods.description: Verifies the adapter's recognition of control messages using a custom control prefix.

methods.name: testMapTopicMapsKuraDataMessagesToTelemetryApi
methods.description: Ensures that data messages with QoS 0 are mapped to the Telemetry API with the configured data message content type.

methods.name: testMapTopicMapsKuraDataMessagesToEventApi
methods.description: Checks that application data messages with QoS 1 are correctly routed to the Event API endpoint and recognized as data messages.

methods.name: assertAddress
methods.description: Helper method to verify that a ResourceIdentifier matches expected endpoint, tenantId, and resourceId.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a mock MQTT publish message with specified QoS and topic, with optional payload.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a MqttContext from a message, endpoint, and device, simulating an incoming MQTT publish for testing.
